description: Update README.md to reflect the new Australian-themed Aussie Serpent game. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-002 in terms of code changes (only touches README.md), but should run after FEAT-002 so the README accurately describes the final game. Updates game description, feature list, and how-to-play instructions to mention Australian theme, food types, obstacles, slang popups, difficulty levels, and high-score tracking.
steps: 1. Read context.json and this FEAT file. Read /projects/sandbox/SnakeGame/README.md.

2. Update README.md: change title to 'Aussie Serpent' or 'Australian Snake Game', update description to mention Australian outback theme, update How to Play section to mention difficulty selection (1/2/3 keys or click), Australian food items (meat pies, vegemite toast, Tim Tams, lamingtons), wildlife obstacles (kangaroos and redback spiders) that appear as score increases, slang popups, and high-score tracking.

3. Update Features list: outback-themed visuals, four Australian food types, wildlife obstacle system, Australian slang popups, session and persistent high-score tracking, three difficulty levels with score multipliers.
4. Update Technical Details: mention the canvas is still 400x400 at 20x20 grid, game speeds vary by difficulty (Easy 150ms, Medium 120ms, Hard 80ms), single HTML file with no dependencies.
5. Commit: git add README.md && git commit -m 'docs: update README for Australian-themed Aussie Serpent game'
